amora.metaTitle: Amora — From 3.04× to 8.11× ROAS in 3 months | ACE Agency
amora.metaDescription: How we grew Meta ROAS from 3.04× to 8.11×, +544% revenue and +288% conversions for Amora (beauty e-commerce) in 3 months through a full funnel and iterative creative.

hero.body: Full cold + retargeting funnel, layered audiences and creative iterated weekly. Scaled +141% spend with CPM -8% — outside peak season.

problem.h2: ROAS stuck at 3× and scaling impossible
problem.body:
Meta budget was being poured massively into generic broad audiences. ROAS sat at 3.04× even during Black Friday windows — a clear sign that efficiency came from the season, not the strategy.

Any attempt to scale the budget broke ROAS — because overlapping audiences cannibalized each other and CPM exploded with no proportional lift in conversions.

solution.body:
We rebuilt the campaign architecture on a funnel: cold (new audiences), warm (recent engagement) and hot (site-visitor + past-buyer retargeting) — with messaging and creative tailored to each layer.

The weekly creative iteration system produced the conversion signals Meta's algorithm needed to optimize efficiently at a larger scale.

steps.title: Audit & audience restructuring
steps.desc: We identified that every campaign was targeting the same broad audiences, cannibalizing reach. We layered them on 4 levels: cold (lookalike 1-2%), warm (engagement 30-90 days), hot (site visitors 7-30 days), conversions (past buyers).

steps.title: Full cold + retargeting funnel
steps.desc: We split campaigns by clear objectives: Awareness / Traffic for cold, Conversions for warm, DPA (Dynamic Product Ads) for hot. Each layer with messaging and creative tailored to its awareness level.

steps.title: Creative iterated weekly
steps.desc: Weekly testing cycle: 3 new creatives per week, killed at 72h if CTR <1% or CPC >target. We tested format (carousel vs. single image vs. reel), message angle (benefit vs. social proof vs. urgency) and visual hook.

steps.title: Scaled +141% spend with CPM -8%
steps.desc: Budget growth happened gradually (+20%/week on campaigns with ROAS >target), avoiding an algorithm reset. Auction competition dropped through more precise audiences, so CPM fell even though spend grew significantly.

testimonial.quote: Meta ROAS jumped from 3× to 8.11× in a season weaker than the previous Black Friday. The season didn't make the difference — the strategy did.
testimonial.author: The Amora team

itmar.metaTitle: ITMAR — From 632k to 2.38M RON in 16 months | ACE Agency

hero.overline: E-COMMERCE · IT REFURBISHED · GOOGLE + META + TIKTOK
hero.h1: From <muted>632k RON</muted> to <accent>2.38M RON</accent> in 16 months
hero.body: Restructured Google Shopping + Performance Max, added Meta and TikTok as complementary channels. 13.34× ROAS on Google, +433% TikTok conversions, without doubling the budget.

problem.h2: Revenue stuck, no path to scale
problem.body:
Google Ads generated 632k RON/year, but any budget increase dropped ROAS. The account was set up with all products in a single campaign with no segmentation, letting the algorithm allocate budget without margin logic.

Zero presence on Meta or TikTok — channels where competition for refurbished IT was much lower and cost per acquisition could be significantly cheaper.

solution.body:
Full Google Shopping rebuild with categories segmented by margin, Performance Max with qualified audience signals, plus building Meta and TikTok presence from scratch.

The new channels didn't cannibalize Google — they created new demand and shortened the buying cycle through cross-channel retargeting.

steps.title: Google Shopping restructuring
steps.desc: The existing account had every product in a single campaign with no segmentation. We restructured by product category (laptops, phones, tablets, accessories), with Smart Bidding calibrated separately on each category and its profit margin.

steps.title: Performance Max with optimized feed
steps.desc: We built Performance Max campaigns with asset groups segmented by intent audiences (in-market IT), a cleaned product feed (optimized titles, competitive prices highlighted, Reconditioned badges) and audience signals from the account's first-party data.

steps.title: Complementary Meta + TikTok channels
steps.desc: Google captured existing demand. Meta and TikTok created new demand — audiences not actively searching for refurbished IT but convinced by the right message (savings + certified quality). Cross-channel retargeting closed the loop.

steps.title: Progressive scaling with Smart Bidding
steps.desc: Budget increases of 15-25% every 7-10 days, only after ROAS stabilized at target. We avoided Google's algorithm reset through gradual changes. 16 months of continuous scaling without major instability.

testimonial.quote: Google Ads revenue climbed from 632k to 2.38M RON in 16 months. We scaled progressively, never jumped blindly.

trady.metaTitle: Trady — From 1.02× to 6.05× ROAS in 2.5 months | ACE Agency

hero.overline: E-COMMERCE · HOME DECOR · META ADS + GOOGLE ADS
hero.h1: From <muted>1.02× ROAS</muted> to <accent>6.05× ROAS</accent> in 2.5 months
hero.body: Killed vanity campaigns, restructured Meta on 7 categories, cut 45% of the Google budget and kept only what converted. Google ROAS simultaneously climbed from 2.64× to 4.40×.

problem.h2: Massive budget on campaigns that didn't sell
problem.body:
Meta ROAS was 1.02× — every leu spent generated 1.02 lei in revenue. Practically, the campaign produced no profit. The account was dominated by Awareness and Engagement campaigns with hundreds of thousands of impressions and zero direct conversions.

Google Ads at 2.64× ROAS was "better" but still under target — and inefficient because 45% of the budget went to unqualified traffic.

cards.label: META ROAS
cards.note: Before · losing money on every leu

solution.h2: Cut vanity spend, focus on conversions
solution.body:
We didn't grow the budget — we redistributed it. Campaigns that didn't generate conversions were stopped immediately, the budget reallocated to campaigns with proven positive ROAS and restructured by product segments with clear margin.

Adding the B2B channel opened a new segment of orders with much higher average value — without significant additional cost.

steps.title: Killed Meta vanity campaigns
steps.desc: The Meta account was full of Awareness, Reach and Engagement campaigns — metrics with no link to sales. We stopped everything that didn't generate conversions or feed the funnel with buying signals. The freed budget was reallocated directly to conversions.

steps.title: Restructured Meta on 7 product categories
steps.desc: Home decor has a wide spectrum of buying intent. We split campaigns into 7 categories (living-room furniture, bedroom, decor, outdoor, textiles, lighting, storage) with different audiences and creative — each category with its own ROAS target based on margin.

steps.title: Google: cut 45% of budget, kept what converted
steps.desc: The Google audit showed that 45% of the budget went to overly broad terms that didn't convert. We cut aggressively and shifted budget to Brand + Competitor + product-category campaigns with high intent. ROAS jumped immediately.

steps.title: Added a B2B channel for wholesale orders
steps.desc: Trady was selling exclusively B2C, but the average order value was already high. We tested a B2B channel (hotels, guesthouses, offices) through Meta with business audiences — orders 10-50× larger per transaction, without cannibalizing the B2C channel.

testimonial.quote: We cut Google budget by 45% and grew ROAS by 67%. On Meta we went from 1× to 6× ROAS. Another agency would have asked us to spend more.
testimonial.author: The Trady team

dosense.metaTitle: doSense — From 15 bookings to 304 leads | ACE Agency

hero.overline: SERVICES · WELLNESS · META ADS LEAD GENERATION
hero.h1: From <muted>15 bookings</muted> to <accent>304 leads</accent> in 3 months
hero.body: One change of objective — from Website Schedules (maximum friction) to Lead Gen with Instant Form (micro-commitment) — multiplied volume 20× and dropped CPL from 394 RON to 52 RON (-87%).

problem.h2: 15 bookings in 3 months at 394 RON each
problem.body:
The Meta campaign objective was Website Schedules — the user had to leave Meta, navigate to the site, find the booking page, fill in a full form and pick a date and time. A complete decision on first contact with the brand.

Result: 15 bookings in 3 months at 394 RON each. The drop-off rate was 96%+. It wasn't an audience problem — it was a friction problem in the funnel.

solution.h2: Micro-commitment instead of a full decision
solution.body:
We changed the objective to Lead Generation with Instant Form. The user stays inside Meta, fills 3 fields in 30 seconds, and the data is pre-populated. The doSense team contacts the lead and books within 24h — more efficient than any booking tool.

The key insight: we didn't need to change the audience or the creative. We needed to remove friction at the moment of the initial decision.

after.label: AFTER — Instant Form · 3 steps
after.summary: Conversion rate ×20 vs. the previous objective

steps.title: Diagnosing the real problem
steps.desc: The original objective was Website Schedules — people had to fill a long form on the site, pick a date and time, confirm. Maximum friction in a single session. We calculated that drop-off between click and booking was 96%+ — an objective problem, not an audience or creative problem.

steps.title: Switching the objective to Meta Lead Gen
steps.desc: We switched the campaign objective to Lead Generation with Instant Form. The user clicks and fills 3 fields (name, phone, type of service wanted) directly inside Meta — without leaving the app. Micro-commitment instead of a full decision. Data is pre-populated from the Meta profile.

steps.title: Instant Form optimized for quality
steps.desc: Not all leads are equal. We added a qualifying question (which service are you interested in?) and a disclaimer (you'll be contacted within 24h). This cut completely unqualified leads and primed the sales follow-up — the team knew exactly what to respond to.

steps.title: Scaled 2.7× with stable CPL
steps.desc: Once we validated the model and CPL stabilized at 52 RON, we grew the budget 2.7× without CPL degrading. The Meta algorithm has clear quality signals (Instant Forms with high engagement) and optimizes efficiently at scale. Volume grew proportionally with budget.

testimonial.quote: We went from 15 bookings in 3 months to 304 leads with the same kind of account. Cost per lead dropped from RON 394 to RON 52.

sections.heading: 1. What cookies are
sections.body:
Cookies are small text files stored on your device (computer, phone, tablet) by your web browser when you visit a site. They allow the site to recognize your device and to remember certain information about your visit.

Cookies do not contain directly identifying personal data and cannot run programs or transmit viruses. They serve only the purposes described in this policy.

There are two main types: session cookies (deleted automatically when you close the browser) and persistent cookies (kept on the device for a set period or until you delete them manually).

sections.heading: 2. Necessary cookies
sections.body:
Essential functional cookies (Necessary, mandatory):
These cookies are indispensable for the site to work correctly. Without them, basic services such as session security, navigation and forms would not work properly.
Tools: Native browser session, CSRF protection, Vercel infrastructure.
Duration: Session (deleted when the browser closes) or up to 1 year for UI preferences.

These cookies cannot be disabled from the consent settings, as disabling them would make the site non-functional. Legal basis: legitimate interest / contract performance.

sections.heading: 3. Analytics cookies
sections.body:

items.question: What ad formats do you use?
